data.notes:
Beauty Will Save the World. Preliminary Syllabus.

When Solzhenitsyn and Dostoyevsky survived gulags they both affirmed: 'Beauty will save the World.' How can this be? 'Beauty' (as a word) has being, and it's related to other dynamic nouns, like 'truth,' 'forgiveness,' 'imagination,' 'peace.' As we enter into 'beauty' we'll be as imaginative as we are analytical. You'll each be asked to present a creative response to our readings, and to bring in examples of Arabic poetry, stories, or ideas compatible with the texts we're discussing. And, you're enjoined to create a scenario in which beauty saves a world: this can be an essay, a story, a poem, a video, a puppet show, a piece of art. Utopian thinking can have practical ramifications.
